value.rationale: Two classical fixed-composition nonparametric statistics (Wald–Wolfowitz runs and Mann–Whitney rank-sum pair count) have constant conditional mean but rigorously oscillating conditional inversion dispersion. A complete all-count variance law and strict parity/local-maximum classification quantify a substantive previously nonobvious feature of joint rank-test calibration. More than a routine marginal formula or numeric slice.
